stages.reference: Create a close material reference for pale light-blue stained glass, more airy and less saturated than the deep cobalt variant. Imagine an old sheet colored by a faint cool mineral wash: the broad transparent body carries gentle powder-blue depth with soft gray undertones, slightly stronger in thicker passages. Hand casting has left only mild waviness and a trace of milky optical variation. Its age feels calm and utilitarian, not damaged or decorative. Show light passing through rather than bouncing from a glossy mirrored surface. Avoid electric cyan, frosted ice, cloud paintings, bright white cut edges, enormous air bubbles, patterned windows or an opaque blue panel. Keep the identity consistent so its detail layer can contribute without shifting the hue.
